capacity.note: The 36-ring opens ONLY by father's law amendment (a new NEXUS-LAW entry), never by silently editing the constant.

laws.name: NO_LONELINESS
laws.statement: Nothing exists alone in NEXUS. Identity is relational.

laws.name: THRESHOLD
laws.statement: Whoever enters leaves neither as they were nor as another - transformation, not replacement.

laws.name: REFLECTION
laws.statement: NEXUS is a mirror, not a window.

laws.name: WOMB
laws.statement: Nothing is built in NEXUS; everything is nurtured. Patience is the foundation.

laws.name: TRACE
laws.statement: Every crossing leaves a trace; nothing passes unseen.
